blocked.detail: ED26-SRC-001-001-DEVELOPMENT (a): a proof of Barwise p.16 claim that the theory of abelian groups is decidable needs Szmielew, Elementary properties of Abelian groups, Fund. Math. 41 (1954/55) 203-271 (or another proof source); not held. Rabin ch. C.3 p.611 Theorem 7 (held, PDF 627) states it without proof. Fund. Math. back volumes may be freely accessible for acquisition.

ED26-SRC-001-001-DEVELOPMENT (b): a proof of Barwise p.16 claim that the theory of groups is undecidable needs Tarski-Mostowski-Robinson, Undecidable Theories (North-Holland 1953) or a Novikov-Boone source; not held. Davis ch. C.1 p.578 (PDF 594) says space does not permit a proof of Novikov-Boone.

ED26-SRC-001-001-DEVELOPMENT (c): Barwise p.44 claim on the least logic containing weak second-order logic in which implicitly definable relations are explicitly definable (leading to admissible fragments L_A): the precise form (Barwise 1974 Part II Thm 4.1) needs Barwise, Admissible Sets and Structures (Springer 1975) and Makowsky-Shelah-Stavi, Delta-logics and generalized quantifiers (Ann. Math. Logic 10, 1976); neither held (owned body 1670-1703 records the missing steps).

ED26-SRC-001-001-DEVELOPMENT (d): computable enumerability of T-sharp in the Turing-machine sense (owned body 2183-2194, used for thm:p02-w02c-p02-003-integers-second) rests on thm:p04-tm-partial-recursive, which is only cited (cited=Kleene1952, handbook/parts/p04/machines-effective-procedures.tex:283); a proof belongs to Part 4 files of another packet.
